criteria.requirement: Implement inflect.streams.iter_join(words,*,sep=", ",pair=" and ",final=", and ") yielding text chunks. Handle zero/one/two/many elements distinctly, consume only finite lookahead (at most three items before first output) and never materialize the whole iterable. Explicit separators avoid the existing join automatic comma scan and can disable Oxford comma. Reject bare str/bytes and non-string words, propagate generator errors, preserve empty string elements and backpressure. Existing engine.join remains unchanged; partial emitted streams are not promised transactional.
